This guide is for people with a seat on a vendor account. If your company has not claimed its listing yet, start with [For vendors](/docs/vendors/overview) and [Claiming your vendor listing](/docs/vendors/claiming-your-listing) in the help center.

## Current limits

Some things the vendor portal does not do yet:

- **Removing a data flow you added.** A corrected row you added stays on record after you cancel the change or pick another direction. It shows again as a row with no answer from you. See [Attesting an integration](/docs/vendors/attesting-an-integration#when-the-direction-is-wrong).
- **Conversations on a contest.** Each side sees the other's reason, note and reply, but there is no back-and-forth. See [Contests and protests](/docs/vendors/contests-and-protests).
- **Adding a catalog match.** On a connector product's **Catalogue** tab, you cannot add a match to a listing that has none. We add those. See [For connector vendors](/docs/vendors/connector-vendors).
